title: Florida Residents Can Eat at GTA 6's Burger Shot Across the State Starting This Week Thanks to a Collaboration With Skinny Louie
summary: GTA 6's fast-food hamburger chain, Burger Shot, is expanding with new locations across Florida starting this weekend thanks to a collaboration with Skinny Louie.

By Cade Onder Updated : Nov 13, 2026 12:44am UTC Add IGN on Google 0 0 GTA 6's fast-food hamburger chain, Burger Shot, is expanding with new locations across Florida starting this weekend thanks to a collaboration with Skinny Louie. Last month, Burger Shot became available at the Kaseya Center , allowing fans to try the real version of the in-game restaurant during Miami Heat games, courtesy of a partnership with a fast-food joint known as Skinny Louie. The chain is now expanding this activation through its standalone stores across Florida. From November 13 to December 31, stores will feature Burger Shot signage, uniforms, and, of course, a menu themed after items in the game. You can take a look at the menu and some images of the food below. GTA 6 Burger Shot x Skinny Louie Collab View 8 Images Skinny Louie's Burger Shot Menu THE BLEEDER — TRIPLE Three 100% Black Angus smash patties with yellow American cheese, crispy bacon, pickles, BBQ sauce, and ketchup. BURGER SHOT — SINGLE One 100% Black Angus smash patty with yellow American cheese, shredded lettuce, diced raw onions, and Burger Shot sauce. BURGER SHOT — DOUBLE Two 100% Black Angus smash patties with yellow American cheese, shredded lettuce, diced raw onions, and Burger Shot sauce. CARAMEL MILKSHAKE GTA 6 Launch Screenshots View 39 Images All of this just goes to show how big GTA 6 has gotten. There aren't many video game franchises that could completely command and rebrand a chain of restaurants, but GTA 6 certainly has that power. The game is already the most pre-ordered title in the history of Xbox and PlayStation's digital stores, and analysts estimate that the game has generated $1 billion in revenue ahead of launch. GTA 6 will officially release next week on November 19 and players can start pre-loading right now . Rockstar has also been trickling out small clips of in-game footage , giving players a taste of what's to come when they load in to Vice City next week.
